key_insight: Data4Cyber links OT network traffic with physical grid behavior to support detection of cyberattacks on solar-integrated distribution management systems.
engineering_relevance: The dataset supports testing intrusion detectors for systems coordinating photovoltaic generation, battery storage, controllable loads, and price-driven operation.
method: Record synchronized process measurements, controller context, price incentives, and Modbus/TCP and MQTT traffic in a laboratory DMS.
Capture one benign baseline and six attack scenarios involving Modbus manipulation, MitM false-data injection, and MQTT price manipulation.
Provide a fixed 1-second time base and phase-resolved labels for temporally blocked, stateful-detector evaluation.
evidence_signal: Baseline evaluations show that high recall can result from alarm saturation, while context-driven attacks require process-aware interpretation.
watch_item: Laboratory results should not be assumed to generalize to deployed grids without validation under field conditions.
paper_title: Data4Cyber: Labeled Cyber-Physical Datasets for Distribution-Grid Management Systems Under Representative OT Attacks
